title: Coffee with Darcy Stubbs
contextText: Coffee with Darcy from Harbourline; no recording.

note.body:
# Coffee with Darcy Stubbs

**Date:** May 21
**Attendees:** Sabin Stubbs, Darcy Stubbs

## Summary

Informal coffee with Darcy Stubbs, product lead at Harbourline, a week after the Rotterdam workshop. Mostly relationship-building, with a short update on their vendor shortlist for the next phase.

## Harbourline update

- Harbourline is choosing an identity-verification vendor for the account-linking step. Darcy has three on the shortlist and wants our view on the user experience of each.
- She liked the workshop format and wants the same structure for the retest readout.

## Action items

- **Darcy Stubbs** — share the identity-verification vendor shortlist with Sabin by next Wednesday.
- **Sabin Stubbs** — prepare a one-page comparison of the three vendors' onboarding flows once the list arrives.

## Personal

- Darcy and Sabin have been friends since university; they met in 2012 in the same first-year halls and have stayed close since. That is partly how Brambleway got the Harbourline introduction.
- Darcy is training for the Porto marathon in October. She has run a marathon every autumn for years and treats marathon running as her main hobby.
- Sabin has taken up long-distance running too and joins her Sunday long runs when he can; he is aiming for his first half marathon.
- Darcy mentioned she tried a pottery class once at a team social last month, but said it was not for her.

## Next steps

Sabin will send the vendor comparison within a week of receiving the shortlist, and we propose the retest readout for the second week of June so Harbourline can decide on the vendor before their planning cycle closes.
